length_standardization: pooled 2018–2021 length distribution within training sample
selection_objective: mean of 44 monthly coverage differences from pooled 2018–2021
validation: two-way PMID split; screening, grouping, word selection and peak months determined in each training half and evaluated in the held-out half
curve_scaling: subtract 44-month mean, divide by Euclidean norm
cluster_naming: ascending mean month index weighted by positive centroid values
